_about: Offline map regions offered in Tools -> Maps -> Download maps, in setup, and by resources\maps\DOWNLOAD-MAPS.ps1. Each key is the file name it's saved as (data\maps\<key>.pmtiles). bbox = min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat (find one at https://boundingbox.klokantech.com/); leave it out for the whole planet. maxzoom limits detail (and size). Sizes were measured with 'pmtiles extract --dry-run' on 2026-10-17 and grow a little as the map data does. Maps are cut from Protomaps' daily world build: https://build.protomaps.com/
